allowedCommands.description: A mapping of CLI binaries to an array of allowed Regex patterns for their arguments. Commands under 'allowedCommands' can be run without confirmation

promptForUnlistedCommands.description: If true, the agent will pause and request confirmation before running unrecognized commands. If false the command will be automatically denied.

unsafeFullAutonomous.description: If true, the agent is allowed to run any arbitrary command without user input.
